articles.summary: HAMBURG, Germany & AUSTIN, Texas --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dec. 3, 2025-- XCHG Limited (“XCharge” or the “Company”), (Nasdaq: XCH), an integrated EV charging and energy solutions company, today announced the establishment of new dual global headquarters located in Hamburg, Germany , and Austin, Texas .
articles.title: XCharge Establishes Dual Global Headquarters in Hamburg, Germany and Austin, Texas, Signaling Strategic Transformation and Strengthened International Market Position
